subject: Request: temporary forensic hold + phased backup purge for Acme Insight
messages:
From: Ruth Grant <ruth.grant@acme-insight.com>
To: se an_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: marco.leone@legalco.com
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary forensic hold + phased purge

Hi Sean,

We discovered a potential data integrity issue tied to a small subset of customer logs stored in your backup tier. Our internal security team has requested a short-term forensic hold on the affected dataset while we complete evidence collection.

We need Redwood to pause the scheduled purge for the named snapshot sets and associated logs for up to 30 days, with the option to extend by another 30 days with justification. Please advise the quickest path to a temporary hold (what metadata you need, whether you require a signed amendment to the DPA, and any ops SLAs we should expect).

I've attached a short note summarizing the request. This is time-sensitive — our incident response team is on a hard deadline for the initial report.

Thanks,
Ruth Grant
Sr. Counsel, Acme Insight
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ruth Grant <ruth.grant@acme-insight.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary forensic hold + phased purge

Hi Ruth —

Thanks for the note and the PDF. We can support a temporary hold on the named snapshots and correlated logs while the investigation completes, but we need to align on three things before operations can pause the purge:

1) Scope: exact snapshot ids and log prefixes (please list them in the Drive doc or in an email)
2) Legal basis: Acme sign-off that this is a forensic/incident hold (email OK for immediate ops; formal amendment to the DPA preferred for holds >14 days)
3) Operational constraints: we need to know whether you require immutable snapshots (we can escrow) or just a non-delete window.

For now, I can provisionally request a 30-day pause with our Storage team once we have the scope. I attached a short phased purge proposal template to capture dates and rollback triggers.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Manager, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: phased-purge-proposal.xlsx
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: se an_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: Ruth Grant <ruth.grant@acme-insight.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 12:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary forensic hold + phased purge

Ruth / Sean —

From a contracts perspective: short holds for incident response are permitted under section 6.2 of the current DPA; however, anything beyond 14 days requires an amendment to the DPA to document the retention carve-out and liability boundaries. Marco — copying you for awareness.

We can accept an email-based confirmation to trigger immediate operational pause (to avoid delaying the investigation). If Acme plans to extend beyond 14 days, please return the attached DPA amendment (I included a draft) signed. The amendment will also request the subprocessor list for the backup tier (CloudStore and any caching partners) and confirm whether cross-border storage locations are implicated.

Next steps I propose:
- Ruth: send snapshot ids + log prefixes by EOD today.
- Acme legal: confirm email approval to pause purges (template in the Drive link).
- Redwood ops (Karthik): queue provisional hold on arrival of scope.

Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-dpa-amendment-draft.docx
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: se an_gallagher@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Ruth Grant <ruth.grant@acme-insight.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary forensic hold + phased purge

Thanks team — ops notes and timeline below.

Ops checklist (what we need from Acme):
- Exact snapshot IDs and log prefixes (full path)
- Indication whether snapshots must be rendered immutable (WORM) or only non-deleted
- Any legal hold identifiers we should add to our audit logs for traceability

Technical approach:
- Phase 1 (Immediate, within 4 hours of scope receipt): set retention flag on snapshots + disable scheduled purge jobs for the indicated keys. Create an audit entry and tag the objects with hold:acme-incident-20280625.
- Phase 2 (Days 1–14): keep objects in place, increase monitoring, daily integrity exports to Acme-specified secure bucket.
- Phase 3 (if hold extends beyond 14 days): require signed DPA amendment; implement escrow snapshot if requested and begin formal escrow handover procedure.

Proposed provisional timeline in absence of signed amendment: 30 days max pause via email authorization, we will auto-notify at day 10 and day 3 before scheduled expiry. If we do not receive a signed amendment and the investigation has not produced an extension justification after 30 days, standard purge will resume automatically.

Operations impact: there is a small storage cost delta for retained snapshots. I estimate ~0.6 TB retained would add ~$1,200 in monthly cost; we can estimate more accurately on scope.

Laura / Sean: please confirm ops proceed after scope arrives. Ruth: send the ids + whether you want WORM or non-delete.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Data Protection & Ops
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ruth Grant <ruth.grant@acme-insight.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary forensic hold + phased purge

All —

We received the snapshot ids and prefixes earlier today (stored in the Drive link). Per Acme request: non-delete hold (not WORM). Acme legal email confirmation attached to the Drive folder. Ops: please enact Phase 1 immediately and confirm when the retention tags and audit entries are created.

Kimberly — Acme indicated there are no cross-border copies beyond our primary US backup region. Please proceed with the email-based 30-day pause; Acme will review and, if needed, return a signed amendment before day 14.

I'll monitor and escalate if we hit any blockers.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Manager, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: acme_forensic_request.pdf, redwood-dpa-amendment-draft.docx, phased-purge-proposal.xlsx
